run the suite through the package's own test script
the other package scripts: build, lint, generate

sandbox.notes: A human runs `npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json`, then `npm test`. `node_modules` arrives linked from the pursuit and one directory is shared by every cell, so `npm ci` and `npm install` are deliberately not declared: either one rewrites the directory the other cells are reading. Adding a dependency is therefore not work for a cell. CI is passed because a test runner that sees it runs once and exits instead of watching, and NPM_CONFIG_CACHE because `npx` resolves an already-downloaded package from the cache instead of reaching for the registry, which a cell cannot rely on. `node --test` is the runner underneath `npm test` and must not be declared as a tool: doctor refuses a bare interpreter, and `node --test` reads to it as a script called `--test`.

work.what: Replace the `any` cast on the incoming payment webhook payload with a discriminated union of the four event kinds the handler acts on, so the compiler rejects a kind nothing handles.
Make the webhook handler idempotent on the event id: a redelivery must not confirm a booking twice.
